hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the symbolic template theta0(x)^2*theta1(x) with the two substitutions. Under associative/commutative multiplication, the first raw factor V(p)*G0(p)*V(p) is the same product; the second is W(q)*H0(q)*W(q) after the analogous substitution.
required_assumptions: Multiplication is associative and commutative for the factor order used in the target members.
hypotheses.rationale: Both reported family members have the same product shape: a squared function times a second function, with only function names and variable symbol changed. This is naturally represented as one parameterized product template with two specializations.
